nom: Clinique Clarifying Face Lotion 1.0 Twice A Day Exfoliator

segments.sensitive: An unusually large number of self-described sensitive-skin reviewers, including many managing rosacea or eczema, report this alcohol-free version calms their skin with no burning, stinging, or redness where other Clinique clarifying formulas failed them; a meaningful minority of reviewers, including some who also describe sensitive skin, instead report burning, itchy red patches, breakouts, or in one case a compromised skin barrier after using it.
segments.dry: A large number of reviewers with dry skin, several combining it with sensitivity, report the alcohol-free formula does not dry them out further and instead leaves skin smoother and less flaky, including some switching from the original alcohol-based version specifically for this reason; two reviewers, comparing it to a discontinued gentler formula, instead find this version too drying and tightening.
segments.combination: Many reviewers with combination skin, especially those who found the alcohol-based Clarifying Lotion 3 too harsh, say the 1.0 version works well without the sting, though several note their combination skin leans dry or oily and adjust their routine around it.
segments.oily: Reviewers who mention oily areas, including one with extremely sensitive yet oily skin, say the salicylic acid helps control oiliness without over-drying the rest of the face.
segments.mature: Reviewers who describe their skin as mature, including one in her 70s and another middle-aged, report brighter, smoother skin and better cell turnover, though the reviewer in her 70s also found the witch hazel in it irritating to her more fragile skin barrier.

concerns.aging: One middle-aged reviewer with mature skin reports looking visibly younger after two weeks of daily use, crediting improved cell turnover; another reviewer instead says the product was so drying it created wrinkles she had never had before.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, including many with chronically dry or flaky skin, say this alcohol-free version does not dry their skin out and even feels moisturizing; a few reviewers, generally comparing it to a gentler discontinued formula, instead describe it as drying, tightening, or flaky.
concerns.redness: A very large number of reviewers, especially those managing rosacea, say the alcohol-free formula calms redness and causes no burning or stinging where older, alcohol-based formulas did; a notable number of others report the opposite with this same product, describing sudden flushing, burning, red patches, or a rosacea flare-up, in one case severe enough to need dermatologist treatment.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports the product severely damaged her skin barrier, leaving her skin stinging even with plain moisturizer for at least a week afterward; another notes her already fragile, aging skin barrier made her more prone to irritation from the witch hazel in the formula.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports several sun-related dark spots faded noticeably after about a month of twice-daily use.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report fewer blackheads, clearer pores, and no new breakouts with regular use; two reviewers instead report new pimples or a severe breakout across the face shortly after starting the product, with one requiring dermatologist treatment.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer says the salicylic acid in the formula helps control oiliness in her T-zone without drying out the rest of her face.

aspects.libelle: Can leave a sticky or filmy residue
Large bottle lasts a long time
Scent is mild but noticeable to some
May cause some moisturizers to pill

extraits.texte: When I used this for the very first time, it made my skin burn and sting, and created multiple red spots on my (previously) clear skin. For the week that followed, I stopped using it, and despite that, every time I applied moisturiser, it would sting, due to my heavily compromised skin barrier. Disappointment. My skin was ruined.

I used the mild clarifying lotion for years back to when it was called the aloe based clarifier. This product is not even close to that product. Instead of camping my rosacea it causes it to flare up. It also causes patches of dryness on my face. Please bring back the old product and stop trying to pass this one off as the replacement.

This product is formulated with so many ingredients that are beneficial for skin. My only challenge with it is the witch hazel because it irritates my dry sensitive skin. At age 70 my skin barrier is not as healthy as it could be, so it's easy for irritation to occur. There are many other Clinique products I am using that do help me, just not this one. Again, this is my response to the product. It may be fine for anyone else.

I purchased it online. The product smelled fermented, like yogurt. After using it, I had breakouts all over my face. I have purchased and used this product a year ago and 01 worked best for my skin in the clarifying series. At first, I thought the ingredients have changed, but after getting serious reaction on my skin, I knew there is something wrong with the product. I ended up going to the dermatologist and paid over $700 for the ointments afterwards. I don't know if the product I received was happened to have a issues, but now I am scared to buy it at least online again and would never reccoment to anyone.

extraits.titre: Changed my skin within a week
extraits.texte: I needed something for sensitive skin that was not too harsh so I tried this. I was shocked at how much dirt came off of my skin even without makeup on. I use it in the morning and at bedtime. Many of my dark spots from the sun have disappeared and my skin appears smoother. I've been using it for about a month.

extraits.titre: 1.0 is the best for sensitive, dry skin
extraits.texte: I have been using 1 or 2 or the men's version for years and always struggled with dryness and redness. I'm a man with sensitive, very dry skin. 1.0 is the solution! My face has never felt better. Finally it feels balanced, not too dry, not too oil, no redness, no itchiness. 1.0 is the magic. This is part of a full routine and using 1.0 has made my skin so much healthier. It may not be for everyone. I've tried many of their "lotions" and exfoliants, and this is the best for me. You have to try a few to find the right now for your skin; which can also change over time.

extraits.titre: Would definitely buy again and again!!
extraits.texte: For a long time I was scared to incorporate an exfoliant into my routine, because I have VERY dry, flaky, and super sensitive skin. My skin has gotten to the point that it was screaming it needs help exfoliating. The Clinique consultant at Ulta recommended me this product, and with it being 50% off at the time I decided to give it a go. It's amazing! It's SUPER gentle, non-drying, and doesn't make my skin feel right afterwards at all. No burning whatsoever, it just feels like water honestly. My skin feels super soft after using and looks glowing. I should have bought both bottles! Highly recommend for all my super dry and sensitive skin girlies.
